title: Pricing matrices goes back to name A to Z after you leave and come back
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA05 alpha) exists.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA05 Beta) exists.
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  3. Click the Matrix Category column header once.
  4. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  5. Read the header arrow and the order of {Matrix-A} and {Matrix-B}.
  6. Click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  7. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  8. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  9. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  10. Read the header arrow and the order of {Matrix-A} and {Matrix-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the header arrow points down and {Matrix-B} is above {Matrix-A}.
  • Step 10: the header arrow points up and {Matrix-A} is above {Matrix-B}. The sort from step 3 was not kept.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10135 (Story 2, Pricing Matrices, sortable column; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S2-R9, §5 Terminology 'Fresh open', read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Pricing matrices), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
